15	`sudo rm -f /etc/s6/repo/compiled/current && sudo s6 set commit -f`

---
name: s6-set-commit-eexist-workaround
description: "Artix s6 — s6 set commit fails with bogus \"File name too long\"; rm the stale current symlink first"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 9b27df11-b962-43e6-86fc-0090c0201497
---

On this Artix s6 machine, `s6 set commit` (s6-frontend 0.0.1.2) fails at its final step with a misleading `s6-rc-set-commit: fatal: ... File name too long`. strace shows the real syscall is `symlink(newdb, /etc/s6/repo/compiled/current) = -1 EEXIST` — it does a plain, non-atomic symlink that can't overwrite the existing `current`, and the errno is reported wrong.

**Why:** A genuine s6-rc-set-commit bug. It blocks the supported recompile pipeline.

**How to apply:** Before committing, remove the stale pointer, then commit:
`sudo rm -f /etc/s6/repo/compiled/current && sudo s6 set commit -f`
The commit then recreates `current` → the new db (with a proper `default` bundle). See [[s6-never-bare-rc-compile]] and [[s6-bootdb-install-in-chroot]].

1	---
2	name: s6-never-bare-rc-compile
3	description: "Artix s6 — always use 's6 set commit', never bare s6-rc-compile, or the default bundle is lost and boot breaks"
4	metadata: 
5	  node_type: memory
6	  type: feedback
7	  originSessionId: 9b27df11-b962-43e6-86fc-0090c0201497
8	---
9	
10	On this Artix s6 machine, recompile the service database with `s6 set commit` (the s6-frontend pipeline), never with a bare `s6-rc-compile`.
11	
12	**Why:** Boot runs `runlevel default` → `s6-rc … change default`. Only `s6 set commit` synthesizes the `default` bundle (from enabled+essential services, via `-D/--default-bundle`). A manual `s6-rc-compile` produces a db with **no `default` bundle**, so boot fails with "no default." This exact failure happened (live db `compiled-local-1781681612277009352`, Jun 2026) and required a live-CD chroot repair.
13	
14	**How to apply:** Use `s6 repository sync` → `s6 set enable/disable …` → `s6 set commit` → `s6 live install`. If `s6 set commit` errors with "File name too long", apply [[s6-set-commit-eexist-workaround]]. To install a committed db from a chroot, see [[s6-bootdb-install-in-chroot]].
15

name: s6-never-bare-rc-compile
description: "Artix s6 — always use 's6 set commit', never bare s6-rc-compile, or the default bundle is lost and boot breaks"
metadata:

On this Artix s6 machine, recompile the service database with `s6 set commit` (the s6-frontend pipeline), never with a bare `s6-rc-compile`.

**Why:** Boot runs `runlevel default` → `s6-rc … change default`. Only `s6 set commit` synthesizes the `default` bundle (from enabled+essential services, via `-D/--default-bundle`). A manual `s6-rc-compile` produces a db with **no `default` bundle**, so boot fails with "no default." This exact failure happened (live db `compiled-local-1781681612277009352`, Jun 2026) and required a live-CD chroot repair.

**How to apply:** Use `s6 repository sync` → `s6 set enable/disable …` → `s6 set commit` → `s6 live install`. If `s6 set commit` errors with "File name too long", apply [[s6-set-commit-eexist-workaround]]. To install a committed db from a chroot, see [[s6-bootdb-install-in-chroot]].

1	---
2	name: s6-bootdb-install-in-chroot
3	description: Artix s6 — how to install a committed db as the bootdb from a chroot (s6 live install needs a running tree)
4	metadata: 
5	  node_type: memory
6	  type: project
7	  originSessionId: 9b27df11-b962-43e6-86fc-0090c0201497
8	---
9	
10	On this Artix s6 machine, the configured bootdb (`/etc/s6-frontend.conf`: `bootdb = /etc/s6/rc/compiled`) is separate from the repo's committed db (`/etc/s6/repo/compiled/current`). `s6 live install` normally bridges them, but it needs a running s6-svscan supervision tree, so it does NOT work from a live-CD chroot.
11	
12	**How to apply (chroot):** After a successful `s6 set commit`, copy the committed db into the bootdb location and repoint the symlink:
13	```
14	src="/etc/s6/repo/compiled/$(readlink /etc/s6/repo/compiled/current)"
15	sudo cp -a "$src" /etc/s6/rc/compiled-<name>
16	sudo ln -sfn /etc/s6/rc/compiled-<name> /etc/s6/rc/compiled
17	```
18	Verify: `s6-rc-db -c /etc/s6/rc/compiled list all | grep -xc default` must be 1. Then **on the next real boot, run `s6 live install` once** so the running tree matches the on-disk bootdb. Old dbs in `/etc/s6/rc/` are kept for rollback (`ln -sfn <old> /etc/s6/rc/compiled`). See [[s6-never-bare-rc-compile]] and [[s6-set-commit-eexist-workaround]].
19

file.content:
---
name: s6-bootdb-install-in-chroot
description: Artix s6 — how to install a committed db as the bootdb from a chroot (s6 live install needs a running tree)
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 9b27df11-b962-43e6-86fc-0090c0201497
---

On this Artix s6 machine, the configured bootdb (`/etc/s6-frontend.conf`: `bootdb = /etc/s6/rc/compiled`) is separate from the repo's committed db (`/etc/s6/repo/compiled/current`). `s6 live install` normally bridges them, but it needs a running s6-svscan supervision tree, so it does NOT work from a live-CD chroot.

**How to apply (chroot):** After a successful `s6 set commit`, copy the committed db into the bootdb location and repoint the symlink:
```
src="/etc/s6/repo/compiled/$(readlink /etc/s6/repo/compiled/current)"
sudo cp -a "$src" /etc/s6/rc/compiled-<name>
sudo ln -sfn /etc/s6/rc/compiled-<name> /etc/s6/rc/compiled
```
Verify: `s6-rc-db -c /etc/s6/rc/compiled list all | grep -xc default` must be 1. Then **on the next real boot, run `s6 live install` once** so the running tree matches the on-disk bootdb. Old dbs in `/etc/s6/rc/` are kept for rollback (`ln -sfn <old> /etc/s6/rc/compiled`). See [[s6-never-bare-rc-compile]] and [[s6-set-commit-eexist-workaround]].

#!/bin/sh
# Safely compile and activate an s6-rc source tree.
#
# Never repoints /etc/s6/rc/compiled before s6-rc-update succeeds. Doing so
# leaves /run/s6-rc/state from the old database paired with a new compiled DB,
# which makes future s6-rc commands fail with "unable to read valid state".
set -eu

S6_SV=${S6_SV:-/etc/s6/sv}

if ! command -v s6-rc-compile >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "s6-rc-compile not found" >&2

fi

if ! command -v s6-rc-update >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "s6-rc-update not found" >&2
    exit 127
fi

if [ ! -d "$S6_SV" ]; then
    echo "service source directory not found: $S6_SV" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$S6_ADMIN" ]; then
    echo "admin source directory not found: $S6_ADMIN" >&2
    exit 1
fi

old_db="$(readlink -f "$S6_COMPILED_LINK" 2>/dev/null || true)"
new_db="${S6_DB_ROOT}/compiled-${LABEL}-$(date +%s%N)"

echo "Compiling s6-rc database: $new_db"
s6-rc-compile "$new_db" "$S6_SV" "$S6_ADMIN"
s6-rc-db -c "$new_db" check

echo "Updating live s6-rc state to: $new_db"
if ! s6-rc-update "$new_db"; then
    echo "s6-rc-update failed; leaving $S6_COMPILED_LINK unchanged" >&2
    [ -n "$old_db" ] && echo "current compiled DB remains: $old_db" >&2
    exit 1
fi

ln -sfnT "$new_db" "$S6_COMPILED_LINK"
echo "Activated s6-rc database: $new_db"

273	    /// Snapshot of all registered components plus a live-update receiver.
274	    ///
275	    /// The receiver fires a `RegistryEvent` every time a component registers,
276	    /// updates, or deregisters.  Use this to mirror the registry into the D-Bus
277	    /// tree without polling.
278	    pub async fn registry_watch(
279	        &self,
280	    ) -> (
281	        Vec<crate::proto::registry::ComponentInfo>,
282	        tokio::sync::broadcast::Receiver<crate::proto::registry::RegistryEvent>,

291	/// Run gRPC server for all Operation services.
292	///
293	/// Includes:
294	///   - StateSync, PluginService, EventChainService, OvsdbMirror, RuntimeMirror
295	///   - ComponentRegistry, MailService, PrivacyNetworkService, RegistrationService
296	///   - gRPC server reflection (all protos in combined descriptor)
297	///   - gRPC health protocol (liveness for deploy verification and load balancers)
298	///
299	/// Adding a new domain service:
300	///   1. Add the generated server import below
301	///   2. Add `.add_service(...)` to the builder chain
302	///   3. Mark it serving via health_reporter
303	pub async fn run_grpc_server(
304	    addr: std::net::SocketAddr,
305	    mutation_engine: Arc<MutationEngine>,
306	    plugin_provider: Option<Arc<dyn PluginSchemaProvider>>,
307	    tls_identity: Option<Identity>,
308	) -> Result<(), tonic::transport::Error> {
309	    use crate::proto::dbus_passthrough_server::DbusPassthroughServer;
310	    use crate::proto::event_chain_service_server::EventChainServiceServer;
311	    use crate::proto::mail::mail_service_server::MailServiceServer;
312	    use crate::proto::ovsdb_mirror_server::OvsdbMirrorServer;
313	    use crate::proto::plugin_service_server::PluginServiceServer;
314	    use crate::proto::privacy::privacy_network_service_server::PrivacyNetworkServiceServer;
315	    use crate::proto::registration::registration_service_server::RegistrationServiceServer;
316	    use crate::proto::registry::component_registry_server::ComponentRegistryServer;
317	    use crate::proto::runtime_mirror_server::RuntimeMirrorServer;
318	    use crate::proto::state_sync_server::StateSyncServer;
319	    use op_cache::grpc::{AgentServiceImpl, McpServiceImpl, OrchestratorServiceImpl};
320	    use op_cache::proto::mcp_service_server::McpServiceServer;
321	
322	    // Build MCP service backed by agent registry.
323	    let agent_svc = std::sync::Arc::new(AgentServiceImpl::new());
324	    let cache_svc = std::sync::Arc::new(op_cache::grpc::CacheServiceImpl::with_ttl(3600));
325	    let orch_svc = std::sync::Arc::new(OrchestratorServiceImpl::with_config(
326	        agent_svc.clone(),
327	        cache_svc,
328	        2,    // workstack_threshold
329	        true, // enable_caching
330	        3,    // promotion_threshold
331	    ));
332	    let mcp_svc = std::sync::Arc::new(McpServiceImpl::new(agent_svc, orch_svc));
333	
334	    let server = if let Some(provider) = plugin_provider {
335	        OperationGrpcServer::with_plugin_provider(mutation_engine, provider)
336	    } else {
337	        OperationGrpcServer::new(mutation_engine)
338	    };
339	    let server = match QdrantSemanticShuttle::new().await {
340	        Ok(shuttle) => server.with_semantic_shuttle(Arc::new(shuttle)),
341	        Err(error) => {
342	            warn!(%error, "semantic shuttle unavailable; SearchSemanticTrace will return failed_precondition");
343	            server
344	        }
345	    };
346	
347	    // Reflection — exposes combined FileDescriptorSet covering all domain protos.
348	    // Enables grpcurl discovery and drives MCP tool auto-registration in op-chat.
349	    // chat.proto is compiled into the combined descriptor set so ChatService is
350	    // discoverable alongside StateSync, PluginService, etc.
351	    let reflection = tonic_reflection::server::Builder::configure()
352	        .register_encoded_file_descriptor_set(crate::proto::FILE_DESCRIPTOR_SET)
353	        .build_v1()
354	        .expect("failed to build reflection service");
355	
356	    // Health — standard gRPC health protocol for deploy verification and LB probes.
357	    let (mut health_reporter, health_service) = tonic_health::server::health_reporter();
358	    health_reporter
359	        .set_serving::<StateSyncServer<OperationGrpcServer>>()
360	        .await;
361	    health_reporter
362	        .set_serving::<PluginServiceServer<OperationGrpcServer>>()
363	        .await;
364	    health_reporter
365	        .set_serving::<EventChainServiceServer<OperationGrpcServer>>()
366	        .await;
367	    health_reporter
368	        .set_serving::<OvsdbMirrorServer<OperationGrpcServer>>()
369	        .await;
370	    health_reporter
371	        .set_serving::<RuntimeMirrorServer<OperationGrpcServer>>()
372	        .await;
373	    health_reporter
374	        .set_serving::<ComponentRegistryServer<OperationGrpcServer>>()
375	        .await;
376	    health_reporter
377	        .set_serving::<MailServiceServer<OperationGrpcServer>>()
378	        .await;
379	    health_reporter
380	        .set_serving::<PrivacyNetworkServiceServer<OperationGrpcServer>>()
381	        .await;
382	    health_reporter
383	        .set_serving::<RegistrationServiceServer<OperationGrpcServer>>()
384	        .await;
385	    health_reporter
386	        .set_serving::<crate::proto::chat::chat_service_server::ChatServiceServer<crate::chat_service::ChatServiceImpl>>()
387	        .await;
388	
389	    info!(addr = %addr, "gRPC bridge listening");
390	
391	    // Wrap services with gRPC-Web support and allow JSON encoding.
392	    // The GhostbridgeInterceptor enforces the Absolute Base rule on every
393	    // inbound request before it reaches a service handler.
394	    let cors = CorsLayer::new()
395	        .allow_origin(Any)
396	        .allow_methods(Any)
397	        .allow_headers(Any);
398	
399	    let mut builder = tonic::transport::Server::builder()
400	        .accept_http1(true)
401	        .layer(cors);
402	
403	    if let Some(identity) = tls_identity {
404	        builder = builder.tls_config(ServerTlsConfig::new().identity(identity))?;
405	    }
406	
407	    let server = builder
408	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(StateSyncServer::with_interceptor(
409	            server.clone(),
410	            interceptor::ghostbridge_interceptor,
411	        )))
412	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(PluginServiceServer::with_interceptor(
413	            server.clone(),
414	            interceptor::ghostbridge_interceptor,
415	        )))
416	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(
417	            EventChainServiceServer::with_interceptor(
418	                server.clone(),
419	                interceptor::ghostbridge_interceptor,
420	            ),
421	        ))
422	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(OvsdbMirrorServer::with_interceptor(
423	            server.clone(),
424	            interceptor::ghostbridge_interceptor,
425	        )))
426	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(RuntimeMirrorServer::with_interceptor(
427	            server.clone(),
428	            interceptor::ghostbridge_interceptor,
429	        )))
430	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(
431	            ComponentRegistryServer::with_interceptor(
432	                server.clone(),
433	                interceptor::ghostbridge_interceptor,
434	            ),
435	        ))
436	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(MailServiceServer::with_interceptor(
437	            server.clone(),
438	            interceptor::ghostbridge_interceptor,
439	        )))
440	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(
441	            PrivacyNetworkServiceServer::with_interceptor(
442	                server.clone(),
443	                interceptor::ghostbridge_interceptor,
444	            ),
445	        ))
446	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(
447	            RegistrationServiceServer::with_interceptor(
448	                server.clone(),
449	                interceptor::ghostbridge_interceptor,
450	            ),
451	        ))
452	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(DbusPassthroughServer::with_interceptor(
453	            server.clone(),
454	            interceptor::ghostbridge_interceptor,
455	        )))
456	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(tonic::codegen::InterceptedService::new(
457	            McpServiceServer::from_arc(mcp_svc),
458	            interceptor::ghostbridge_interceptor,
459	        )))
460	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(
461	            crate::proto::chat::chat_service_server::ChatServiceServer::new(
462	                crate::chat_service::ChatServiceImpl::new(),
463	            ),
464	        ))
465	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(reflection))
466	        .add_service(tonic_web::enable(health_service));
467	
468	    server.serve(addr).await
469	}

475	#[tonic::async_trait]
476	impl StateSync for OperationGrpcServer {
477	    type SubscribeStream = Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<ProtoStateChange, Status>> + Send>>;
478	
479	    async fn subscribe(
480	        &self,
481	        request: Request<SubscribeRequest>,
482	    ) -> Result<Response<Self::SubscribeStream>, Status> {
483	        let req = request.into_inner();
484	        info!("gRPC Subscribe: plugins={:?}", req.plugin_ids);
485	
486	        let mut rx = self.mutation_engine.change_tx().subscribe();
487	        let plugin_filters = req.plugin_ids;
488	        let path_filters = req.path_patterns;
489	        let tag_filters = req.tags;
490	
491	        let stream = stream! {
492	            loop {
493	                match rx.recv().await {
494	                    Ok(update) => {
495	                        let matches_plugin = plugin_filters.is_empty()
496	                            || plugin_filters.contains(&update.plugin_id);
497	                        let matches_path = path_filters.is_empty()
498	                            || path_filters.iter().any(|p| update.object_path.starts_with(p));
499	                        let matches_tag = tag_filters.is_empty()
500	                            || update.tags_touched.iter().any(|t| tag_filters.contains(t));
501	
502	                        if matches_plugin && matches_path && matches_tag {
503	                            yield Ok(proto_state_change(&update));
504	                        }
505	                    }
506	                    Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(n)) => {
507	                        warn!("Subscriber lagged, missed {} updates", n);
508	                        continue;
509	                    }
510	                    Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed) => break,
511	                }
512	            }
513	        };
514	
515	        Ok(Response::new(Box::pin(stream)))
516	    }
517	
518	    async fn mutate(
519	        &self,
520	        request: Request<MutateRequest>,
521	    ) -> Result<Response<MutateResponse>, Status> {
522	        let req = request.into_inner();
523	        let value = prost_value_to_simd(&req.value.unwrap_or_else(|| ProstValue::from(0)));
524	        let change_type = match req.operation {
525	            x if x == ProtoOperationType::SetProperty as i32 => ChangeType::PropertySet,
526	            x if x == ProtoOperationType::CallMethod as i32 => ChangeType::MethodCall,
527	            x if x == ProtoOperationType::ApplyPatch as i32 => ChangeType::ObjectAdded,
528	            _ => ChangeType::PropertySet,
529	        };
530	
531	        let result = self
532	            .mutation_engine
533	            .mutate(
534	                req.plugin_id.clone(),
535	                req.object_path.clone(),
536	                change_type,
537	                if req.member_name.is_empty() {
538	                    None
539	                } else {
540	                    Some(req.member_name.clone())
541	                },
542	                value,
543	                req.actor_id.clone(),
544	                if req.capability_id.is_empty() {
545	                    None
546	                } else {
547	                    Some(req.capability_id.clone())
548	                },
549	            )
550	            .await;
551	
552	        match result {
553	            Ok(ok) => Ok(Response::new(MutateResponse {
554	                success: ok.success,
555	                event_id: ok.event_id,
556	                event_hash: ok.event_hash,
557	                result: ok.result.map(|v| simd_to_prost_value(&v)),
558	                error: None,
559	                effective_hash: String::new(),
560	            })),
561	            Err(e) => Ok(Response::new(MutateResponse {
562	                success: false,
563	                event_id: 0,
564	                event_hash: String::new(),
565	                result: None,
566	                error: Some(ProtoMutationError {
567	                    code: ProtoErrorCode::Internal as i32,
568	                    message: e.to_string(),
569	                    deny_reason: None,
570	                }),
571	                effective_hash: String::new(),
572	            })),
573	        }
574	    }
575	
576	    async fn get_state(
577	        &self,
578	        request: Request<GetStateRequest>,
579	    ) -> Result<Response<GetStateResponse>, Status> {
580	        let req = request.into_inner();
581	        let state = self.mutation_engine.get_state(&req.plugin_id).await;
582	
583	        let state_struct = state
584	            .map(|v| simd_to_prost_struct(&v))
585	            .unwrap_or_else(ProstStruct::default);
586	
587	        Ok(Response::new(GetStateResponse {
588	            state: Some(state_struct),
589	            effective_hash: String::new(),
590	            at_event_id: 0,
591	        }))
592	    }
593	
594	    async fn batch_mutate(
595	        &self,
596	        request: Request<BatchMutateRequest>,
597	    ) -> Result<Response<BatchMutateResponse>, Status> {
598	        let req = request.into_inner();
599	        let mut results = Vec::new();
600	        let mut failed_index = -1;
601	
602	        for (idx, m) in req.mutations.into_iter().enumerate() {
603	            let mut_req = Request::new(m);
604	            let resp = self.mutate(mut_req).await?.into_inner();
605	            if !resp.success && failed_index < 0 && req.atomic {
606	                failed_index = idx as i32;
607	                break;
608	            }
609	            results.push(resp);
610	        }
611	
612	        Ok(Response::new(BatchMutateResponse {
613	            success: failed_index < 0,
614	            results,
615	            failed_index,
616	        }))
617	    }
618	}

710	    async fn get_property(
711	        &self,
712	        request: Request<GetPropertyRequest>,
713	    ) -> Result<Response<GetPropertyResponse>, Status> {
714	        let req = request.into_inner();
715	        let connection = Connection::system()
716	            .await
717	            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(e.to_string()))?;
718	        let proxy = zbus::fdo::PropertiesProxy::builder(&connection)
719	            .destination(format!("org.opdbus.{}.v1", req.plugin_id))
720	            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(e.to_string()))?
721	            .path(req.object_path.as_str())
722	            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(e.to_string()))?
723	            .build()
724	            .await
725	            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(e.to_string()))?;
726	
727	        let iface = zbus::names::InterfaceName::try_from(req.interface_name.as_str())
728	            .map_err(|e| Status::invalid_argument(e.to_string()))?;
729	        let val: ZOwnedValue = proxy
730	            .get(iface, req.property_name.as_str())
731	            .await
732	            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(e.to_string()))?;
733	
734	        let json =
735	            simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(&val).map_err(|e| Status::internal(e.to_string()))?;
736	
737	        Ok(Response::new(GetPropertyResponse {
738	            value: Some(simd_to_prost_value(&json)),
739	            read_only: false,
740	        }))
741	    }

743	    async fn set_property(
744	        &self,
745	        request: Request<SetPropertyRequest>,
746	    ) -> Result<Response<SetPropertyResponse>, Status> {
747	        let req = request.into_inner();
748	        let connection = Connection::system()
749	            .await
750	            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(e.to_string()))?;
751	        let proxy = zbus::fdo::PropertiesProxy::builder(&connection)
752	            .destination(format!("org.opdbus.{}.v1", req.plugin_id))
753	            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(e.to_string()))?
754	            .path(req.object_path.as_str())
755	            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(e.to_string()))?
756	            .build()
757	            .await
758	            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(e.to_string()))?;
759	
760	        let iface = zbus::names::InterfaceName::try_from(req.interface_name.as_str())
761	            .map_err(|e| Status::invalid_argument(e.to_string()))?;
762	        let value = prost_value_to_simd(&req.value.unwrap_or_else(|| ProstValue::from(0)));
763	        let zval =
764	            simd_json_to_zvariant(&value).map_err(|e| Status::invalid_argument(e.to_string()))?;
765	
766	        proxy
767	            .set(iface, req.property_name.as_str(), zval.into())
768	            .await
769	            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(e.to_string()))?;
770	
771	        Ok(Response::new(SetPropertyResponse {
772	            success: true,
773	            event_id: 0,
774	            event_hash: String::new(),
775	            error: None,
776	        }))
777	    }

779	    async fn subscribe_signals(
780	        &self,
781	        request: Request<SubscribeSignalsRequest>,
782	    ) -> Result<Response<Self::SubscribeSignalsStream>, Status> {
783	        let req = request.into_inner();
784	        let plugin_filter = req.plugin_id;
785	        let signal_names = req.signal_names;
786	        let path_filter = req.object_path;
787	
788	        // Subscribe to the schema engine's change broadcast and filter for signals
789	        let mut rx = self.mutation_engine.change_tx().subscribe();
790	
791	        let stream = stream! {
792	            loop {
793	                match rx.recv().await {
794	                    Ok(update) => {
795	                        // Only emit Signal change types
796	                        if update.change_type != ChangeType::Signal {
797	                            continue;
798	                        }
799	                        // Plugin filter
800	                        if !plugin_filter.is_empty() && update.plugin_id != plugin_filter {
801	                            continue;
802	                        }
803	                        // Path filter
804	                        if !path_filter.is_empty() && !update.object_path.starts_with(&path_filter) {
805	                            continue;
806	                        }
807	                        // Signal name filter
808	                        let signal_name = update.member_name.clone().unwrap_or_default();
809	                        if !signal_names.is_empty() && !signal_names.contains(&signal_name) {
810	                            continue;
811	                        }
812	
813	                        yield Ok(Signal {
814	                            plugin_id: update.plugin_id.clone(),
815	                            object_path: update.object_path.clone(),
816	                            interface_name: String::new(),
817	                            signal_name,
818	                            arguments: vec![simd_to_prost_value(&update.new_value)],
819	                            timestamp: Some(ProstTimestamp {
820	                                seconds: update.timestamp.timestamp(),
821	                                nanos: update.timestamp.timestamp_subsec_nanos() as i32,
822	                            }),
823	                        });
824	                    }
825	                    Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(n)) => {
826	                        warn!("Signal subscriber lagged, missed {} updates", n);
827	                        continue;
828	                    }
829	                    Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed) => break,
830	                }
831	            }
832	        };
833	        Ok(Response::new(Box::pin(stream)))
834	    }

846	    async fn get_events(
847	        &self,
848	        request: Request<GetEventsRequest>,
849	    ) -> Result<Response<GetEventsResponse>, Status> {
850	        let req = request.into_inner();
851	        let chain = self.mutation_engine.event_chain.clone();
852	        let chain = chain.read().await;
853	
854	        let events: Vec<ProtoChainEvent> = chain
855	            .events()
856	            .iter()
857	            .filter(|e| req.from_event_id == 0 || e.event_id >= req.from_event_id)
858	            .filter(|e| req.to_event_id == 0 || e.event_id <= req.to_event_id)
859	            .filter(|e| req.plugin_id.is_empty() || e.plugin_id == req.plugin_id)
860	            .filter(|e| req.tags.is_empty() || e.tags_touched.iter().any(|t| req.tags.contains(t)))
861	            .filter(|e| match req.decision_filter {
862	                x if x == ProtoDecision::Allow as i32 => e.decision == Decision::Allow,
863	                x if x == ProtoDecision::Deny as i32 => e.decision == Decision::Deny,
864	                _ => true,
865	            })
866	            .take(if req.limit == 0 {
867	                usize::MAX
868	            } else {
869	                req.limit as usize
870	            })
871	            .map(proto_chain_event)
872	            .collect();
873	
874	        let has_more = req.limit > 0 && (events.len() as u32) == req.limit;
875	        Ok(Response::new(GetEventsResponse { events, has_more }))
876	    }
877	
878	    async fn subscribe_events(
879	        &self,
880	        request: Request<SubscribeEventsRequest>,
881	    ) -> Result<Response<Self::SubscribeEventsStream>, Status> {
882	        let req = request.into_inner();
883	        let mut rx = self.chain_events.subscribe();
884	        let plugin_filter = req.plugin_id;
885	        let tag_filters = req.tags;
886	
887	        let stream = stream! {
888	            loop {
889	                match rx.recv().await {
890	                    Ok(event) => {
891	                        let matches_plugin = plugin_filter.is_empty() || event.plugin_id == plugin_filter;
892	                        let matches_tag = tag_filters.is_empty() || event.tags_touched.iter().any(|t| tag_filters.contains(t));
893	                        if matches_plugin && matches_tag {
894	                            yield Ok(event);
895	                        }
896	                    }
897	                    Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_)) => continue,
898	                    Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed) => break,
899	                }
900	            }
901	        };
902	
903	        Ok(Response::new(Box::pin(stream)))
904	    }

1231	fn simd_to_prost_value(value: &simd_json::OwnedValue) -> ProstValue {
1232	    use prost_types::value::Kind;
1233	    if value.as_null().is_some() {
1234	        return ProstValue {
1235	            kind: Some(Kind::NullValue(0)),
1236	        };
1237	    }
1238	    if let Some(b) = value.as_bool() {
1239	        return ProstValue {
1240	            kind: Some(Kind::BoolValue(b)),
1241	        };
1242	    }
1243	    if let Some(n) = value.as_f64() {
1244	        return ProstValue {
1245	            kind: Some(Kind::NumberValue(n)),
1246	        };
1247	    }
1248	    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {
1249	        return ProstValue {
1250	            kind: Some(Kind::StringValue(s.to_string())),
1251	        };
1252	    }
1253	    if let Some(arr) = value.as_array() {
1254	        let vals = arr.iter().map(simd_to_prost_value).collect();
1255	        return ProstValue {
1256	            kind: Some(Kind::ListValue(prost_types::ListValue { values: vals })),
1257	        };
1258	    }
1259	    if let Some(obj) = value.as_object() {
1260	        let fields = obj
1261	            .iter()
1262	            .map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), simd_to_prost_value(v)))
1263	            .collect();
1264	        return ProstValue {
1265	            kind: Some(Kind::StructValue(ProstStruct { fields })),
1266	        };
1267	    }
1268	    ProstValue {
1269	        kind: Some(Kind::NullValue(0)),
1270	    }
1271	}

1273	fn prost_value_to_simd(value: &ProstValue) -> simd_json::OwnedValue {

1276	        None => simd_json::json!(null),
1277	        Some(Kind::NullValue(_)) => simd_json::json!(null),
1278	        Some(Kind::BoolValue(b)) => simd_json::json!(*b),
1279	        Some(Kind::NumberValue(n)) => simd_json::json!(*n),
1280	        Some(Kind::StringValue(s)) => simd_json::json!(s),
1281	        Some(Kind::StructValue(s)) => {
1282	            let mut map = simd_json::value::owned::Object::new();
1283	            for (k, v) in &s.fields {
1284	                map.insert(k.clone(), prost_value_to_simd(v));
1285	            }
1286	            simd_json::OwnedValue::Object(Box::new(map))
1287	        }
1288	        Some(Kind::ListValue(l)) => {
1289	            let arr = l.values.iter().map(prost_value_to_simd).collect::<Vec<_>>();
1290	            simd_json::OwnedValue::from(arr)
1291	        }
1292	    }
1293	}

1295	fn simd_json_to_zvariant(value: &simd_json::OwnedValue) -> Result<ZOwnedValue, anyhow::Error> {

1297	        if let (Some(sig_val), Some(inner)) = (obj.get("sig"), obj.get("value")) {

1300	            }
1301	        }
1302	    }
1303

1306	    }
1307	    if let Some(b) = value.as_bool() {

1309	    }
1310	    if let Some(i) = value.as_i64() {

1312	    }
1313	    if let Some(u) = value.as_u64() {

1315	    }

1325	fn zvariant_from_sig(
1326	    sig: &str,
1327	    value: &simd_json::OwnedValue,
1328	) -> Result<ZOwnedValue, anyhow::Error> {
1329	    match sig {
1330	        "s" => value
1331	            .as_str()
1332	            .map(|v| ZOwnedValue::from(ZStr::from(v)))
1333	            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Expected string for sig 's'")),
1334	        "b" => value
1335	            .as_bool()
1336	            .map(ZOwnedValue::from)
1337	            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Expected bool for sig 'b'")),
1338	        "i" => value
1339	            .as_i64()
1340	            .map(|v| ZOwnedValue::from(v as i32))
1341	            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Expected i32 for sig 'i'")),
1342	        "u" => value
1343	            .as_u64()
1344	            .map(|v| ZOwnedValue::from(v as u32))
1345	            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Expected u32 for sig 'u'")),
1346	        "x" => value
1347	            .as_i64()
1348	            .map(ZOwnedValue::from)
1349	            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Expected i64 for sig 'x'")),
1350	        "t" => value
1351	            .as_u64()
1352	            .map(ZOwnedValue::from)
1353	            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Expected u64 for sig 't'")),
1354	        "d" => value
1355	            .as_f64()
1356	            .map(ZOwnedValue::from)
1357	            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Expected f64 for sig 'd'")),
1358	        "ay" => {
1359	            let arr = value
1360	                .as_array()
1361	                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Expected array for sig 'ay'"))?;
1362	            let bytes: Result<Vec<u8>, anyhow::Error> = arr
1363	                .iter()
1364	                .map(|v| {
1365	                    v.as_u64()
1366	                        .map(|n| n as u8)
1367	                        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Expected u8 in ay array"))
1368	                })
1369	                .collect();
1370	            ZOwnedValue::try_from(ZValue::Array(ZArray::from(bytes?)))
1371	                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Array conversion error: {}", e))
1372	        }
1373	        _ => Err(anyhow::anyhow!("Unsupported signature '{}'", sig)),
1374	    }
1375	}

content.text:
I have the full picture now. Here's the diagnosis, then one decision I need from you before I change code.

## What the refactor left misconfigured

**The bridge is fine.** After the refactor, `op-grpc-bridge-zeroclaw` correctly serves two listeners (`server.rs`):
- **Unix socket** `/run/ghostbridge/container.sock` → native gRPC, **and reflection IS registered** there (`server.rs:188` registers `tonic_reflection` with `FILE_DESCRIPTOR_SET` on this route). ✅
- TCP `0.0.0.0:8090` → HTTP + gRPC-Web.

**The client is the problem — two breaks:**

1. **`deploy/s6/zeroclaw/run` never sets `ZEROCLAW_GRPC`.** So the `zeroclaw` GUI falls back to its default `http://127.0.0.1:18789` (`main.rs:24`) — its own gateway port, not the bridge. That's why reflection bootstrap fails: it's dialing the wrong place / a name (`assistant.3tched.com:50051`) that, per your point, *shouldn't resolve to an IP at all*.

2. **The client can't dial a socket even if you point it at one.** Both connect sites — `grpc.rs:103` and `chat/transport.rs:55` — use `Endpoint::from_shared(endpoint).connect()`, which is TCP/HTTP only. To honor "it should be a socket," the client needs `connect_with_connector` + a UDS connector so `unix:/run/ghostbridge/container.sock` actually dials the socket.

So your instinct in the worklog was right: the `10.220.35.1` / `assistant.3tched.com:50051` path the previous agent proposed is the wrong architecture. The assistant container has no IP — the GUI should reach the bridge over `/run/ghostbridge/container.sock`.

The fork that determines whether I write Rust:

## Reconstructed topology

   • 0.0.0.0:8090                     → HTTP + gRPC-Web

## What's actually wrong (confirmed in the tree)

1. **Bridge is correct** — reflection IS registered on the Unix socket route (`server.rs:188`). The endpoint you want ("grpc-bridge is the endpoint, http+grpc via tonic, reflection") already exists at `/run/ghostbridge/container.sock`.
2. **Xray ingress dials TCP, not the socket** — `config.socket.json`'s `grpc-bridge-out` does `redirect: 127.0.0.1:18789`. That's the IP/port path you objected to; nothing here dials the container's native socket.
3. **zeroclaw client** — never sets `ZEROCLAW_GRPC` (`deploy/s6/zeroclaw/run`) and can't dial a UDS anyway (`Endpoint::from_shared` is TCP-only).

What I **couldn't** find in the repo: the incus proxy device / bind-mount that exposes `/run/ghostbridge/container.sock` to Xray or into the container — that looks configured live, not in-tree.

Client leg is done and **compiles clean** (`cargo check` exit 0; the warnings are all pre-existing dead-code, none from my change).

## Done — Leg 2: zeroclaw console → native socket
- `src/conn.rs` (new): `connect_channel()` dials `unix:/…` via tonic `connect_with_connector` + `UnixStream`, falls back to TCP for `http://…`.
- `grpc.rs` (reflection bootstrap) and `chat/transport.rs` (ChatService) now both use it.
- `Cargo.toml`: added `tokio/net` + `tower/util`.
- `deploy/s6/zeroclaw/run`: `ZEROCLAW_GRPC=unix:/run/ghostbridge/container.sock`.

So the console now reaches the bridge's reflection + ChatService over the socket — no IP, no DNS. That directly fixes the `assistant.3tched.com` reflection failure.

## Two things I need you on before touching the rest

**1. Xray leg — your "native socket" contradicts the repo's own finding.** `netmaker.handoff` records (line 540): *"Xray 26.5.9 doesn't support domainsocket transport. The correct path is incus proxy devices … then xray uses normal TCP freedom redirects."* Its proven data flow is:
```
xray inbound :443 → freedom redirect 127.0.0.1:<port>
  → incus proxy (bind=container, listen=tcp:127.0.0.1:<port> → connect=unix:/run/…sock on host)
  → incus proxy on target container (listen=unix:/run/…sock → connect=tcp:127.0.0.1:<svc>)
```
So I should **not** write a `domainsocket` outbound into `config.socket.json` — the repo already proved it fails. The socket leg is done by incus proxy devices, not Xray.

**2. "use plugin method."** Right now the console invokes via `grpc.rs::invoke_unary` — a *generic reflected* call to any service/method. I read "use plugin method" as: route plugin actions through **`PluginService.CallMethod`** (which goes through the MutationEngine + ghostbridge interceptor for accountability) instead of arbitrary reflected RPCs. Want to confirm before I rewire dispatch.

Here's where things actually stand, with the live host facts.

## cognitive mcp — yes, working (with one caveat)
- `op-cognitive-mcp` is **up and stable**: PID 740, **15h19m** uptime, s6-supervised, not flapping.

- **Caveat:** the **Qdrant semantic-trace** backend isn't reachable on the host (no 6333/6334, only the incus *command* socket exists — no data socket/port). So vector semantic-search (`SearchSemanticTrace` / `QdrantSemanticShuttle`) is degraded/unavailable; core memory is fine. Also no log sink found for the service (observability gap).

## Your actual question: does the host have a plugin unix socket? — **Yes**
`/run/ghostbridge/container.sock` is **listening on the host** (confirmed via `ss -x`), served by `op-grpc-bridge-zeroclaw`. That socket *is* the plugin surface — `PluginService` (list/get_schema/**call_method**) + reflection + ChatService, all on it. So "use plugin method" = call `PluginService.CallMethod` over that socket, and the console change I already made points there.

**But xray isn't using it.** The live host config `/etc/xray/config.json` dials **TCP** `127.0.0.1:18789` (and friends) — not the socket. Since xray has native bidirectional UDS (you're right; I was wrong to cite the retired netmaker note), the fix is to point the assistant route's `dest` at `unix:/run/ghostbridge/container.sock`.

I kept reasoning from stale repo artifacts (`netmaker.handoff`, `wg-xray` container devices) instead of the host-native reality. Let me save the current topology so it stops happening:

160	/// native-gRPC (Unix socket) and gRPC-Web (TCP) listeners expose exactly the
161	/// same services. Includes:
162	///   - ZeroclawService    — plugin-owned schema get/watch
163	///   - PluginService      — MutationEngine-backed CallMethod (createunixsocket, …)
164	///   - DbusPassthrough    — generic D-Bus call/get/set/watch, same surface every
165	///     container gets; lets the assistant container reach the unix-socket plugin's
166	///     createsocket method through this one endpoint
167	///   - ChatService        — operator chat stream (delegator, forced tool calling)
168	///   - gRPC reflection    — combined FileDescriptorSet so the assistant container's
169	///     zeroclaw-gui discovers every service from this one endpoint
170	///
171	/// Every container shares this surface over the one `container.sock`; the assistant
172	/// container is provisioned exactly like the others (its socket created via the
173	/// unix-socket plugin's createsocket, not a raw Incus proxy device).
174	fn build_routes(
175	    loader: Arc<SchemaLoader>,
176	    plugin_service: PluginSvcIntercepted,
177	    dbus_service: DbusSvcIntercepted,
178	) -> tonic::service::Routes {
179	    let service = ZeroclawGrpcService { loader };
180	    let zeroclaw_svc = tonic_web::enable(ZeroclawServiceServer::new(service));
181	    let plugin_svc = tonic_web::enable(plugin_service);
182	    let dbus_svc = tonic_web::enable(dbus_service);
183	    let chat_svc = tonic_web::enable(ChatServiceServer::new(ChatServiceImpl::new()));
184	
185	    // Reflection exposes the combined descriptor set covering every domain proto
186	    // (including chat.proto), so grpcurl/zeroclaw-gui can `list` and resolve
187	    // method schemas over this single endpoint.
188	    let reflection = tonic_web::enable(
189	        tonic_reflection::server::Builder::configure()
190	            .register_encoded_file_descriptor_set(crate::proto::FILE_DESCRIPTOR_SET)
191	            .build_v1()
192	            .expect("failed to build reflection service"),
193	    );
194	
195	    tonic::service::Routes::new(zeroclaw_svc)
196	        .add_service(plugin_svc)
197	        .add_service(dbus_svc)
198	        .add_service(chat_svc)
199	        .add_service(reflection)
200	}

202	/// Build the axum `Router` that serves the gRPC service over HTTP/gRPC-Web.
203	pub fn build_axum_app(
204	    loader: Arc<SchemaLoader>,
205	    plugin_service: PluginSvcIntercepted,
206	    dbus_service: DbusSvcIntercepted,
207	) -> Router {
208	    let cors = CorsLayer::new()
209	        .allow_origin(Any)
210	        .allow_methods(Any)
211	        .allow_headers(Any);
212	
213	    build_routes(loader, plugin_service, dbus_service)
214	        .into_axum_router()
215	        .layer(cors)
216	        .layer(GhostbridgeTraceLayer::new())
217	}

220	fn build_tonic_routes(
221	    loader: Arc<SchemaLoader>,
222	    plugin_service: PluginSvcIntercepted,
223	    dbus_service: DbusSvcIntercepted,
224	) -> tonic::service::Routes {

226	}

228	/// Run the zeroclaw Axum host.
229	///
230	/// Returns only when both listeners exit (which should not happen under normal
231	/// operation).
232	pub async fn run_zeroclaw_server(config: ServerConfig) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
233	    let loader = Arc::new(SchemaLoader::new(&config.schema_path)?);
234	
235	    // Channel for D-Bus-triggered rebind requests. Only `SchemaPath` changes are
236	    // applied live; `BindAddr` changes are recorded and honored on the next
237	    // restart.
238	    let (rebind_tx, mut rebind_rx) = mpsc::channel::<String>(4);
239	
240	    // D-Bus object for runtime configuration.
241	    let dbus_object = ZeroclawAxumHostObject::new(loader.clone(), rebind_tx)?;
242	    let _dbus_connection = register_zeroclaw_host_object(dbus_object).await?;
243	
244	    // SIGHUP reload watcher.
245	    let _sighup_handle = loader.clone().watch_sighup();
246	
247	    // PluginService (PluginService.CallMethod) backed by the authoritative
248	    // MutationEngine. This is how createunixsocket is invoked: a CallMethod with
249	    // plugin_id="unix_socket" routes through MutationEngine.mutate →
250	    // UnixSocketPlugin::create_unix_socket. The sled identity is resolved as
251	    // the actor_id inside mutate when the caller omits it.
252	    let event_chain = Arc::new(tokio::sync::RwLock::new(
253	        op_state_store::EventChain::new(op_state_store::ChainConfig::default()),
254	    ));
255	    let ovsdb = Arc::new(op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient::new());
256	    let nonnet = Arc::new(op_jsonrpc::nonnet::NonNetDb::new());
257	    let mutation_engine = Arc::new(MutationEngine::new(event_chain, ovsdb, nonnet));
258	    let operation_server = OperationGrpcServer::new(mutation_engine);
259	    let plugin_service = PluginServiceServer::with_interceptor(
260	        operation_server.clone(),
261	        crate::interceptor::GhostbridgeInterceptor,
262	    );
263	    // DbusPassthrough — generic D-Bus call/get/set/watch, same surface every
264	    // container gets. The interceptor enforces the Absolute Base rule on every
265	    // inbound request before it reaches a handler.
266	    let dbus_service = DbusPassthroughServer::with_interceptor(
267	        operation_server,
268	        crate::interceptor::GhostbridgeInterceptor,
269	    );
